verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document versioned Restate APIs (for example, a versioned admin or ingress API) or any deprecation or support-window policy. The versioning docs (restate-docs-24, restate-docs-41) cover immutable deployments of the user's own services, not the stability of Restate's own APIs. The SDK changelogs only list new features and say nothing about deprecations.
